Location: Petrie, QLD, 4502
Full-Time: Immediate start
Reports to: Centre Manager & ECT
Job Title: Child Care Worker
Salary range: $79,500 - $86,600 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date: 30 days

About This Role:
Our client is a well-established early learning provider committed to nurturing children's growth through play-based learning and holistic development. With purpose-built facilities and a team of dedicated educators, they create warm, inclusive environments where children feel safe to explore, learn and thrive. Their philosophy emphasizes emotional wellbeing, creativity and foundational skill-building during these crucial early years. We're seeking a nurturing Childcare Worker to join their team. This role goes beyond supervision - you'll actively contribute to children's developmental milestones while fostering their curiosity through engaging, age-appropriate experiences.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
Program Delivery & Child Development:
• Design and implement stimulating educational programs aligned with the Early Years Learning Framework (EYLF)
• Facilitate intentional teaching moments through play-based activities including storytelling, music, art and sensory exploration
• Observe and document children's progress to support individual learning goals and share insights with families
• Guide social-emotional development by modelling positive behaviour and conflict resolution strategies

Daily Care & Wellbeing:
• Maintain impeccable hygiene standards including nappy changing, toileting assistance and mealtime supervision
• Create predictable routines that provide children with emotional security while allowing flexibility for spontaneous learning
• Conduct thorough safety checks of indoor/outdoor environments and resources before activities
• Administer first aid when required and follow health management plans for children with additional needs

Family & Community Engagement:
• Build trusting relationships with families through daily conversations and formal progress updates
• Collaborate with room leaders to create displays that make children's learning visible to parents
• Participate in community events and centre initiatives that strengthen family connections

Compliance & Professionalism:
• Maintain current working with children check - first aid certification and relevant qualifications
• Contribute to quality improvement processes through reflective practice
• Attend staff meetings and professional development sessions to enhance practice

Skills & Requirements:
• Certificate III or Diploma in Early Childhood Education & Care (or ACECQA-approved equivalent)
• Proven 1-year minimum experience in long day care or similar setting.
• Demonstrated knowledge of EYLF and National Quality Standards
• Genuine passion for early childhood development with endless patience and creativity
• Current First Aid, Asthma & Anaphylaxis certificates as well as proof of vaccination
• Working with children rights
• Police check
• Strong communication skills to engage with children, colleagues and families
• References from previous employers

Why Apply?
This is more than a job - it's an opportunity to shape young lives in an environment that values educator wellbeing as much as child development. You'll receive:

• Above-award wages for qualified candidates
• Paid professional development opportunities
• Supportive leadership team with realistic expectations
• Purpose-built facilities with quality resources

If you're ready to make your mark in early childhood education with an organisation that values your expertise, we'd love to hear from you.

How to Apply:
Submit your resume and cover letter addressing your experience with the EYLF and your approach to play-based learning. Successful applicants will require valid working rights and must pass background checks.

Please note: We are acting as recruitment agents on behalf of our client. Employer details will be provided to shortlisted candidates.

result.description: Savic Motorcycles Limited   About the Role   We are seeking a Mechanical Engineer to design, develop, validate and improve the mechanical systems, components and manufacturing processes of the Savic C-Series electric motorcycle platform. This is an engineering role covering the full product lifecycle, from concept design through to production readiness, with genuine ownership of components and systems on a market-leading Australian-designed electric motorcycle.   Key Responsibilities    Design, develop and optimise mechanical components, assemblies and vehicle systems for the Savic C-Series platform and upcoming models, including chassis, suspension, bodywork, mounting systems and structural components.  Translate performance, durability, safety and manufacturing requirements into engineering specifications, drawings, tolerances and technical documentation.  Develop manufacturing-ready designs using Design for Manufacture and Assembly principles, GD&T, tolerance stack-up analysis and material selection.  Perform and support engineering analysis including finite element analysis, fatigue analysis and topology optimisation, and develop and execute mechanical test plans and validation procedures.  Support the transition of designs from prototype to repeatable, production-ready manufacture, including release of manufacturing drawings, work instructions and inspection requirements.  Design or support the development of jigs, fixtures, gauges and other production aids to improve quality, safety and repeatability.  Maintain Engineering Change Management records, Bills of Materials, drawing releases and New Product Introduction documentation, including DFMEA, PFMEA and PPAP activities.  Lead FRACAS Meetings focusing on analysis, quality assurance and continuous improvement functions of mechanical components, in alignment with the software, systems and electrical engineering teams.    Support structured root-cause analysis and corrective action processes and maintain fault and corrective action records in Notion or other nominated engineering systems.  Identify opportunities to improve cost, manufacturability, weight and performance of components and assemblies, and evaluate alternative materials and manufacturing methods.  Work closely with Electrical, Software, Systems, Manufacturing, Quality and Aftersales teams to ensure mechanical systems integrate effectively with the wider vehicle platform.    What We're Looking For    Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.  Demonstrated experience designing, developing and validating mechanical components, assemblies or systems in an automotive, motorcycle, EV, manufacturing, aerospace, robotics or related product-development environment.  Strong capability in mechanical design for manufacture, including GD&T, tolerance stack-up analysis, materials selection, manufacturing drawings and production documentation.  Experience with engineering analysis and validation methods, including FEA, fatigue assessment, physical testing, data acquisition or structured test planning.  Experience applying engineering quality and risk-management methods such as DFMEA, PFMEA, 8D, 5D, DMAIC, DFSS, PPAP or equivalent.  Experience supporting engineering change management, BOM control, drawing release and New Product Introduction processes.  Strong practical understanding of manufacturing processes, tooling, jigs, fixtures, machining, casting, fabrication or assembly methods.  Proficient with CAD, PLM/PDM, project management, engineering documentation and issue-tracking systems; experience with Notion, Jira, Odoo or equivalent systems is highly regarded.    Our Brand   In this role, you will act in accordance with our brand values and help us deliver our brand vision: to make EV riding enjoyable to every rider in the world.   We put people first — our customers are at the heart of what we do.  We design in Australia — being an Aussie brand is in our DNA.  We make informed decisions — using data, insights and experience.  We actually care — each person is personally passionate about what we're doing.      About Company      Savic Motorcycles is redefining the electric motorcycle industry with premium, high-performance machines that blend cutting-edge technology, sleek design and an exclusive brand experience. Our Engineering team is responsible for ensuring Savic motorcycles are safe, reliable, manufacturable, commercially viable, and continuously improving as the business scales. The centre prides itself on its beautiful, natural settings and its philosophy that emphasises emotional security, creativity, and foundational learning through exploration. We are looking for a dedicated professional who can contribute to this nurturing atmosphere, design a stimulating program inspired by the Early Years Learning Framework, and build strong, collaborative relationships with families and the wider community. This is a unique opportunity to join a team deeply committed to providing an exceptional early learning experience.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
Program Delivery & Child Development:
• Design and implement stimulating educational programs aligned with the Early Years Learning Framework (EYLF)
• Facilitate intentional teaching moments through play-based activities including storytelling, music, art and sensory exploration
• Observe and document children's progress to support individual learning goals and share insights with families
• Guide social-emotional development by modelling positive behaviour and conflict resolution strategies

Daily Care & Wellbeing:
• Maintain impeccable hygiene standards including nappy changing, toileting assistance and mealtime supervision
• Create predictable routines that provide children with emotional security while allowing flexibility for spontaneous learning
• Conduct thorough safety checks of indoor/outdoor environments and resources before activities
• Administer first aid when required and follow health management plans for children with additional needs

Family & Community Engagement:
• Build trusting relationships with families through daily conversations and formal progress updates
• Collaborate with room leaders to create displays that make children's learning visible to parents
• Participate in community events and centre initiatives that strengthen family connections

Compliance & Professionalism:
• Maintain current working with children check - first aid certification and relevant qualifications
• Contribute to quality improvement processes through reflective practice
• Attend staff meetings and professional development sessions to enhance practice

Skills & Requirements:
• Certificate III or Diploma in Early Childhood Education & Care (or ACECQA-approved equivalent)
• Proven 1-year minimum experience in long day care or similar setting.
• Demonstrated knowledge of EYLF and National Quality Standards
• Genuine passion for early childhood development with endless patience and creativity
• Current First Aid, Asthma & Anaphylaxis certificates as well as proof of vaccination
• Working with children rights
• Police check
• Strong communication skills to engage with children, colleagues and families
• References from previous employers

Why Apply?
This is more than a job - it's an opportunity to shape young lives in an environment that values educator wellbeing as much as child development. You'll receive:

• Above-award wages for qualified candidates
• Paid professional development opportunities
• Supportive leadership team with realistic expectations
• Purpose-built facilities with quality resources

If you're ready to make your mark in early childhood education with an organisation that values your expertise, we'd love to hear from you.

How to Apply:
Submit your resume and cover letter addressing your experience with the EYLF and your approach to play-based learning. Successful applicants will require valid working rights and must pass background checks.

Please note: We are acting as recruitment agents on behalf of our client. Employer details will be provided to shortlisted candidates.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to develop practical and cost-effective engineering solutions.
